name: @marktiderman/genesis-work
description: Goals and projects, tasks and issues, metrics, status updates and sessions for Genesis apps, in the app's own Supabase (schema genesis_work): owned by a person, a team or the tenant through genesis-supabase's owner-access contract.

feature.name: Pursuits
feature.summary: Goals and projects (one table, either or both) with tasks, issues and milestones, owned by a person, a team or the tenant; who reads and writes is the app's hook.

steps: Define private.genesis_readable_owners(viewer) and private.genesis_owner_can(tenant, viewer, person_id, team_id, organization_id, action) in a migration, as the header of 0009 shows. Without them nobody signed in reads or writes.
Add genesis_work to your API's exposed schemas (supabase/config.toml [api] schemas).

feature.name: Metrics
feature.summary: Numbers tracked over time (a scorecard, a habit, a profit margin), one value per period, goals that change over time, owned by a person, a team or the tenant.

steps: Uses the owner-access block's hooks: private.genesis_readable_owners(viewer) and private.genesis_owner_can(...). Without them nobody signed in reads or writes.
Add genesis_work to your API's exposed schemas (supabase/config.toml [api] schemas).

feature.name: Status updates
feature.summary: Dated updates (health and a note) on goals, projects, tasks, issues and metrics, and requests to a person for an update by a due time, answered by posting one.

steps: Needs the pursuits and metrics blocks and their hooks. For reminders, schedule a job (the jobs block) that reads update_requests_due and sends one notification per request.
Add genesis_work to your API's exposed schemas (supabase/config.toml [api] schemas).

feature.name: Sessions
feature.summary: Sessions of any kind (a meeting, workshop, presentation, coaching call, one-on-one, class or planning day): types with agendas, a schedule and calendar event, the agenda copied at start, the live step, notes and recordings; attendees with presence and a 1-to-10 rating; links to pre-work and collaboration spaces.

steps: Uses the owner-access block (genesis-supabase) and its app hooks. To share pre-work or a live worksheet with attendees, register private.genesis_session_members(session) as a collaboration audience.
Add genesis_work to your API's exposed schemas (supabase/config.toml [api] schemas).

feature.name: Custom fields
feature.summary: A tenant's own fields on goals, projects, tasks, issues, metrics and sessions, with no code or migration: genesis-forms field types, values in a custom jsonb checked by shape, app and content-pack fields that only server code writes.

steps: Validate custom values on the server with the genesis-forms engine before writing; the database checks only their shape and that a field exists.

feature.name: Content pack install
feature.summary: Install a content pack (session types, metric templates, custom fields, labels) into a tenant's own editable rows; updates are additive and keep what the tenant changed; uninstalling removes only untouched, unused items.

steps: Install packs from server code: check that a tenant admin asked, then call genesis_work.install_content_pack(tenant, manifest, person) with the service role. Forms and roadmap templates in a manifest are the app's to install.
